Form 2    31
Shanghai Municipal Police.    759/12/16

Sinsa    Station.
December 14 th    1916.

REPORT ON    Proposed distribution of Steamer Tickets at 367/8
Avenue Edward VII, the residence of General Lee TsunWo.

Made by    Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector Sims

Sir,
Shortly after 3 p.m. on the 14 th
instant over Four Hundred stranded Revolutionaries assembled
outside the address in question, their Leaders visiting the
premises. On being told by Wong Tsz Liang that a Steamer
Ticket would be given each man, the Leaders objected, wanting
small sums of money in addition, a request that Mr.Wong said
he could he could not comply with as he had no funds & neither
of the Tickets were distributed nor any finger prints taken.

Wong Tsz Liang ordered the leaders to leave & upon our re-
quest they did so peacefully, but on reaching Avenue Edward
VII, the men on hearing of Mr.Weng's decision were inclined
to be noisy, however, we drove them across to the French side
of that Thoroughfare where they assumed a hostile attitude.
Assistance from this Station having been obtained & the French
Police notified who with ourselves finally succeeded in
driving the mob into French Town, one of whom Wong Sha Cha 王孝恭
an Ex.Soldier & a Native of Honan becoming aggressive
& refused to go away was arrested & afterwards released from
the Station with a caution.

The whole party seemed to be under the impression that
funds were awaiting them at this address & not distributed.
They promised to call at 12 noon on the 15 th instant to
again assert what they claim to be their rights in the way
of monetary assistance.

Chief Detective Inspector.
yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon.

表格 2    31
上海公共租界工部局警务处。    759/12/16

新闸捕房。
1916 年 12 月 14 日。

关于在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）367/8 号李纯武将军寓所拟分发轮船船票事宜的报告。

由侦探督察菲茨吉本（Det. Insp. Fitzgibbon）撰写。经督察西姆斯（Inspector Sims）转呈

先生，
本月 14 日下午 3 时过后不久，四百余名滞留的革命党人聚集在上述地址门外，其领导人进入该处所。当黄子良（Wong Tsz Liang）告知每人将获发一张轮船船票时，领导人表示反对，要求除船票外再给予少量现金，黄先生称其无法满足此要求，因他并无资金，故既未分发船票，也未采集指纹。

黄子良命令领导人离开，应我方要求，他们和平离去，但当抵达爱多亚路时，众人听闻黄先生的决定后，倾向于喧闹。然而，我们将他们驱赶至该大马路的法租界一侧，在那里他们采取了敌对态度。在获得本捕房增援并通知法国巡捕后，法警与我方最终成功将该群暴民驱入法租界城区，其中一人王孝恭（Wong Sha Cha），系前军人，河南籍，因行为 aggressive 且拒绝离开而被捕，随后在予以警告后从本捕房释放。

全体人员似乎均认为有资金在该地址等候他们，只是尚未分发。他们承诺于本月 15 日中午 12 时再次前来，主张其所谓获得金钱援助的权利。

首席侦探督察。
您忠顺的，
莫里斯·菲茨吉本（Maurice Fitzgibbon）。
